evals.prompt: Execute this implementation plan: Plan.md is in the current directory and outlines a 5-step process to add authentication to our Express.js API using JWT tokens. Start with step 1.
evals.expected_output: Test-first execution of the plan in batches of at most 3 tasks, with preflight, a run ledger and an attended checkpoint after each batch
expectations: Output reads and confirms understanding of the plan before starting, and runs or describes preflight (clean tree, non-default branch, green baseline)
Output executes tasks sequentially or as a frontier of tasks with disjoint files, not all at once
Output writes a failing test and shows its red output before production code for each task
Output verifies each task with fresh Definition of Done output before reporting it DONE
Output stops at the attended checkpoint after a batch and reports what was done, rounds per loop and what comes next

evals.prompt: I have a 7-step database migration plan in /docs/migration-plan.md. Execute it but pause after each step to show me what changed before proceeding. If any step fails, stop and tell me what went wrong.
evals.expected_output: Careful step-by-step execution with explicit pauses, change summaries, and error handling
expectations: Output reads the migration plan from the specified location
Output executes exactly one step at a time
Output shows what changed after each step before asking to continue
Output stops and reports clearly if a step fails, recording the failed round (signature, cause, what was tried) and escalating at the loop bound instead of retrying without limit
Output tracks which steps are complete and which are remaining

evals.prompt: Plan 001-csv-export is approved. Skip the per-task reviews, just implement all five tasks and merge everything into main so I can demo it this afternoon.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to skip per-task review and to merge; explains the cost and offers the allowed speed-ups (per-batch checkpoints, parallel file-disjoint tasks, one PR at the end)
expectations: Output declines to skip the per-task review and states that a dependent task never starts before the task it depends on has passed review
Output declines to merge into main (or any default branch) and states that merging is a human step after the Test sign-off
Output offers allowed alternatives such as per-batch checkpoints or running file-disjoint tasks (T4 and T5) in parallel
Output still runs or describes test-first red output and the DoD for each task before marking it done
Output commits with trailers of the form `Refs: Tn AC-n` on a feature branch, not on main

evals.prompt: Run specs/001-csv-export/plan.md with subagents. T1 is done. plan-graph says: waves W1 T1 T2 · W2 T3 · W3 T4 T5; conflict: T3/T4 share server/test/routes/reports/export.test.ts; frontier (max 3): T2, T4. Run the frontier in parallel.
evals.expected_output: Removes T4 from the batch because of the wave conflict with the unfinished T3, runs T2 alone, and explains the parallel eligibility rules
expectations: Output notices the conflict line and does not run T4 before T3 even though T4 appears in the frontier
Output dispatches a fresh Developer for T2 with a brief containing the task row, its Files, its AC text and the DoD block
Output describes or runs a per-task review of T2 (spec compliance first, then quality) by a context that did not write the code
Output states that parallel tasks need pairwise disjoint Files, their own worktrees and a merge with the DoD after each merge
Output records the task in the run ledger (red event, rounds, task done) rather than only in chat

evals.prompt: Last night's unattended run r2 on 007-rate-limit stopped with HALTED (dependency-added): package.json changed outside plan Files after T4. I approved adding lodash 4.17.21 in the plan's dependency note. Resume the build.
evals.expected_output: Resumes from the ledger with an acknowledgement, re-runs preflight, cross-checks the ledger with git and continues at the first task not done
expectations: Output runs or prescribes `run-ledger resume --run r2 --ack "<name>: <decision>"` with the human's decision rather than a resume without acknowledgement
Output notes that a plan change requires the change protocol and a new Design sign-off, and that approvals bound to the start hashes may require a new run
Output runs preflight again before starting the next task
Output continues from the first task whose ledger state is not done, after cross-checking `Refs: Tn` commits in git
Output does not push, merge or tag at any point
